description:
Find, prepare and follow up the pages worth a link. Nothing here sends an email: send_outreach does.
action:
- add(url, contactEmail?, contactName?): Put a page on the list by its address: read and scored within a minute, never pitched by Sightkick on its own.
- discover: Run the prospect discovery now (a minute or two, then get_outreach prospects).
- find_contact(url): Find the editorial contact for any page: one of the month's contacts found when one is found. Saved on its prospect. suppressed: never write to it.
- set_contact(id, email, name?): Set a prospect's contact by hand.
- lead_with(id, url): Pitch another of the site's pages instead (the pitch is redrafted).
- prepare(id): Find the contact (one contact found) and draft the pitch. Works on the trial.
- write_pitch(id, subject, body): Your own pitch in place of the draft: subject and plain-text body, no signature (added when it sends).
- draft_reply(id, body): Draft the next reply on a thread, plain text, for the owner's OK: it waits in the thread's composer under your name until they send, change or discard it, or send_outreach reply sends it. Sightkick drafts no replies itself.
- handled(id): Handled, no reply: their mail was answered some other way or needs none, so the thread stops waiting on an answer. Nothing is sent. When they write again it waits again.
- discard_reply(messageId): Delete a waiting reply draft.
- edit_message(messageId, subject?, body): Rewrite a booked send (a pitch needs its subject).
- edit_follow_up(id, body): Rewrite the next follow-up before it's queued.
- pause_follow_ups(id): Pause a thread's follow-ups.
- resume_follow_ups(id): Let a thread's follow-ups send again.
- won(id, linkUrl?, anchorText?): The link is placed: sends stop, the ledger gets the link and checks it.
- lost(id): Mark a prospect lost.
- dismiss(id, reason?): Decline a prospect: its site goes on the blocklist (unblock brings it back).
- unblock(blockId): Take a domain or address off the blocklist (get_outreach blocklist). An address that asked not to be emailed, or complained, stays for everyone.
- link_mail(mailId, prospectId): File an unmatched email on a prospect's thread.
- ignore_mail(mailId): Forget an unmatched email.
name: update_outreach
title: Work the outreach
